Obě nákladní lodě útočné drony zaměřily nedaleko bulharského pobřeží, oznámil dnes Radev.
První z nich „zasáhly tři vzdušné drony“, popsal bulharský premiér. Tuto loď identifikoval jako Ukrajinou vlastněné plavidlo, které plulo pod jménem Chelsea 3 a maltskou vlajkou.

The French navy intercepted and boarded an oil tanker linked to Russia’s so-called shadow fleet in the Indian Ocean, President Emmanuel Macron announced Monday.
The French joint staff said naval inspectors boarded the vessel to verify its nationality after doubts arose over its claimed Benin registration. The operation took place around 450 nautical miles south of Réunion Island, an overseas territory of France.
Macron said the ship — the DF Peak — was suspected of sailing under a false flag and being involved in illicit fuel transportation. The vessel is under U.S., EU, U.K. and Ukrainian sanctions.
The tanker was being escorted to Réunion for further checks, said armed forces minister Catherine Vautrin.
The DF Peak is at least the sixth shadow-fleet tanker French authorities have detained over the past year, according to the exiled outlet The Insider.

France seizes Russian ‘shadow fleet’ oil tanker in Indian Ocean
October 13, 2026, 7:22 am
Source: Emmanuel Macron
France’s navy detained an oil tanker called the DF Peak that belongs to the “shadow fleet” on October 12, French President Emmanuel Macron said.
The tanker was detained more than 450 nautical miles south of Réunion Island in the Indian Ocean. Authorities suspect it was flying a false flag and illegally transporting fuel.
According to  data from Marinetraffic, the tanker was sailing under Benin’s flag and was headed to the port of Cruz Grande in Chile. It wasn’t clear where the vessel had sailed from.
The magazine Maritime Executive writes that the tanker was built in 2006 and originally belonged to the company Sovcomflot, sailing under the name NS Captain . It was renamed Kaliningrad in 2024 and took its current name in 2025. Its operator is now a company based in Hong Kong.
Maritime Executive also says that Benin’s national registry, whose flag the tanker flies, was once “considered a haven for Russia-linked shadow fleet vessels.” The U.S. sanctioned the tanker in February…

RFE/RL’s Balkan Service and the investigative project Sistema have identified a diplomat at the Russian Embassy in Serbia who was declared persona non grata in Bulgaria in 2021 during an investigation into explosions at weapons depots.
Alexander Krasiy, an assistant military attaché, held the same position at the Russian Embassy in Bulgaria before moving to Serbia. titulek: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
titulekPuvodni: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
shrnuti: Hundreds of stores were targeted by the overnight hack, which spoiled fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros.

vyrez.text:
Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack - BBC News
Image source, AFP via Getty Images
By Ian Aikman
Published
1 hour ago
Hundreds of French supermarkets have been hit by a cyber attack that caused their fridges and freezers to heat up, spoiling fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros.
Hackers reportedly gained control of the software that regulates the temperatures of the refrigeration units, forcing some to warm to 50C (120F) overnight.
The chief executive of Coopérative U said several of its supermarkets had been hit by the "extremely serious and unprecedented" attack.
More than 100 of the chain's supermarkets were targeted, while at least 300 stores from Intermarché and its Netto brand were affected, according to the AFP news agency.
Intermarché said its fridges had heated up to 50C for six hours overnight into Monday, and the retailer had thrown away all the affected food to avoid health risks, the Reuters news agency reported.
Some supermarket staff reportedly said they were hit by waves of hot air when they opened freezer units on Monday morning.

Stock photo
Three consecutive Ukrainian drone attacks on data centres operated by Russian technology company Yandex have caused disruptions to more than 80 of its digital platforms and third-party but related services, such as banking apps and ride-hailing services. Bot traffic from the Yandex network has also fallen to almost zero.

As a result, bot traffic fell to 0.4% of the peak level recorded over the previous two weeks.

Germany’s federal prosecutor’s office has said a former domestic intelligence chief was arrested on Tuesday on espionage allegations.
August Hanning served as president of the Federal Intelligence Service (BND) from December 1998 to November 2005.
Hanning was arrested in Bad Toelz-Wolfratshausen, in southern Germany. A former aide of his, identified only as Manfred D, was also arrested on Tuesday.

Source: Meduza
A bomb destroyed a car belonging to a participant in Russia’s war against Ukraine on October 2 in Novomoskovsk, in Russia’s Tula region, the Ukrainian monitoring Telegram channel Exilenova+ reported.
The bomb had been planted under the car’s chassis, according to  data from the anonymous Russian Telegram channel VChK-OGPU. The driver killed was identified as Roman Syromyatnikov, and the Novomoskovsk-based news outlet Novomoskovsk Segodnya confirmed the death of a person by that name.
Syromyatnikov worked at Russia’s Federal Penitentiary Service (FSIN) facilities in the Tula region during the 2010s. He signed a contract with Russia’s Defense Ministry in 2023 and returned to the Tula region for medical treatment in late 2024, the independent Russian investigative outlet iStories reported , citing leaked data.

Source: Operational Command of the Polish Armed Forces
A Russian military Mi-8 helicopter entered Polish airspace on September 23 at 11:08 a.m., the operational command of the Polish army said.
The helicopter, flying from the Kaliningrad region, crossed about 300 meters (984 feet) into Polish airspace and remained there for 42 seconds, the Polish military said.
Poland scrambled fighter jets and put ground forces and equipment on alert. “The nature of the incident indicates that Russia is once again testing the readiness of our air defense,” the command said.
Russia has not yet commented on the incident.
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said on September 17 that Russia is planning “hybrid” strikes using missiles and drones against countries that support Ukraine. He claimed that “there is a real risk that drones or other types of missiles may fly into the territory of one or more NATO countries on the eastern flank, even cause destruction.”

Wadephul sieht Europa im Fadenkreuz Russlands

Ein mutmaßlicher Sabotageakt in Polen, die Verdächtigen leben in Deutschland: Außenminister Wadephul fordert eine noch engere europäische Zusammenarbeit. Zur Attacke gegen eine Starlink-Station wurden Details bekannt.
Nach dem Brand einer Starlink-Station in Polen und der Festnahme zweier Verdächtiger gestern in Deutschland hat Außenminister Johann Wadephul eine noch engere europäische Zusammenarbeit gegen hybride Angriffe gefordert.
"Wir sind im Fadenkreuz Russlands", sagte der CDU-Politiker vor Journalisten am Rande eines Sicherheitsforums in der polnischen Hauptstadt Warschau. "Wir werden angegriffen und das geschieht eben nicht nur in der Ukraine, sondern überall in Europa", warnte Wadephul. "Das bedeutet, wir müssen unsere Zusammenarbeit verstärken." Zuvor hatte er sich mit seinem polnischen Kollegen Radoslaw Sikorski beraten.
Zugleich zeigten die Festnahmen in Deutschland, dass die Zusammenarbeit beim Thema Sicherheit funktioniere,…

A total of 88 drones were downed. Infographic: Ukraine's Air Force
Russia attacked Ukraine with five ballistic missiles, nine drone-launched missiles and 108 drones on the night of 12-13 October. Air defence forces have destroyed or jammed 88 UAVs.
Source: Ukraine's Air Force
Details: From 18:00 on 12 October, the Russians used five Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles launched from Russia's Bryansk Oblast, nine Banderol/Dan-T drone missiles and 108 Shahed and Gerbera attack drones, as well as Parodiya decoy UAVs. Seventy-four of the drones were jet-powered.

The drones were launched from the Russian cities of Oryol, Kursk and Primorsko-Akhtarsk, as well as from temporarily occupied Donetsk and Hvardiiske in Crimea.
Early reports indicated that as of 08:00, Ukrainian air defence forces had destroyed or jammed 88 drones (58 jet-powered).

PM Andy Burnham said it would 'almost certainly' be Iran's IRGC that was pulling the strings Image: House of Commons/PA Images/picture alliance Advertisement
The British government has accused Iran of involvement in a security alert outside a UK/US airbase in southern England last month , summoning the ambassador and announcing sanctions against two individuals.

Článek
V desítkách francouzských supermarketů přestala fungovat chladicí zařízení a řada čerstvých nebo mražených potravin se zkazila, informoval v pondělí francouzský deník Ouest-France. Podle Dominiqua Schelchera, šéfa maloobchodního řetězce Coopérative U, šlo o kybernetický útok. Škody jsou podle francouzských médií velké. Incident se týká asi 150 prodejen řetězců U, Intermarché a E.Leclerc.
„Naše týmy jsou plně mobilizovány a ve spolupráci s odborníky na chladicí techniku se snaží situaci co nejrychleji napravit. Vyšetřování by mělo objasnit všechny okolnosti tohoto útoku,“ napsal šéf družstva Schelcher v příspěvku na síti X . Útok odsoudil a označil za „mimořádně závažný“ a „nepřijatelný“ čin.
Hackeři…

titulekPuvodni: Three injured in Russian drone attack on Kyiv
shrnuti: Three people were injured in Kyiv in a Russian drone attack on 12 October. Drone debris fell on a house in the Darnytskyi district and near residential buildings in the Solomianskyi district.

vyrez.text:
Three injured in Russian drone attack on Kyiv | Ukrainska Pravda
Stock photo: Getty Images
Three people were injured in Kyiv in a Russian drone attack on 12 October. Drone debris fell on a house in the Darnytskyi district and near residential buildings in the Solomianskyi district.
Source : Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko
Quote : "The number of people injured in the capital has risen to three."
Advertisement:





Details : Drone debris fell on a house in the Darnytskyi district and on an open area near houses in the Solomianskyi district. Emergency services were dispatched to both locations.
Klitschko initially reported one person injured, who received medical assistance at the scene. He later reported another injured person, an elderly woman who was also treated at the scene. The number of injured subsequently rose to three.
Background : On 11 October, State Emergency Service bomb disposal experts removed a warhead and safe remnants of a ballistic missile from the site of one of the Russian strikes in Kyiv's Obolonskyi district.

NATO 's top military commander is expected to deliver a warning to Russia on Monday over the alliance's ability to counter any attack, as worries grow over the threat from Moscow .

Západní zpravodajské služby varovaly šéfy evropských zbrojních firem, že Rusko zesiluje snahy o jejich zabití, píše deník Financial Times (FT). Firmy proto zpřísňují ochranu svých nejvyšších představitelů. Kreml podle deníku i kvůli patové situaci na bojišti na Ukrajině nařídil rozšíření sabotáží a „hybridních“ operací v Evropě, aby se mu v příštích měsících podařilo zásadně oslabit podporu Kyjeva.
„Atentáty na evropské civilní cíle – dříve dokonce i ruskými zpravodajskými službami považované za tabu – jsou stále důležitější součástí těchto plánů,“ uvádí list .
Financial Times mluvil s představiteli pěti evropských zpravodajských služeb, kteří varovali, že šéfové zbrojních firem i vysoce postavení zaměstnanci se stávají terčem Kremlu. Podle těchto…
